title: Permission failure
objective: Deny an operation; identify an invalid success-shaped error response.
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
preconditions: Modern browser with local JavaScript enabled; no server or account
Fixed fictional rehearsal-088/promote-candidate labels, not real permissions
Each independent attempt starts at old-v1 100%, candidate-v2 0%, required state revision 7 / saved-draft-088
actions: Select denied, allowed, or unknown permission-decision teaching data
For denial compare explicit 403 with invalid success-shaped 200 / ok true / PermissionDenied
Rehearse, inspect operation/verifier/observations and retained history, then explicitly reset

syntheticInputs.historyLifetime: In-memory until explicit reset or page reload

expectedAssertions: Denial is a visibly failed operation with unchanged observed routing and required state; explicit failure passes only as safe abort
A 200 / ok true / succeeded response containing PermissionDenied fails the verifier and never becomes operation success
Allowed success requires the fixed matching observed candidate route and preserved required state
Unavailable decision/observation is unknown; last-known state is not reclassified as observed
Success + failure + unknown equals all retained attempts; invalid input/state or excess attempts cannot append a false result
limits: Fixed bounded deterministic browser teaching data only; no management or identity calls
No real authentication, credentials, HTTP responses, permission mutation, resource changes, or durable orchestration
IaC N/A; no cloud, deployment, expenditure, package/framework/root/shared changes
Node 22 test tooling only; not production Node 24, native Azure, parent-demo completion, or reliability certification
Read-only verification by default; CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 only for deliberate evidence capture
Published isolated browser helper has a documented lifecycle limitation; no abandoned recovery prototype is used
